_source.script: a recorder of 2026-10-28 that is not part of the repository; the cases are listed here with their results
_source.how: docker run -d --network none IMAGE sleep 300, then docker exec -i NAME grep ARGS with the stdin of the case; stdout, stderr and status kept apart; a long number in stdout or stderr is stored as <ARG:i> (the i-th argument without its dash), a number of N nines in arguments as {digits: N}; every case ran on every image listed under images for its set, none of the results is copied from another image
_source.derived: the boundary of 21 digits for a number bundled with options (-n777...) and the -A0 separator of GNU grep before 3.8 are not recorded
_source.images: image -> style, libc, version, image id, repo digests, platform
